applied.problem: Screen 1 states that a drive holds V/Hz steady as a universal rule; it holds only below rated speed for plain V/f control. The card and screen 14 say a drive is the same chain as a UPS, which would give a drive a battery on its DC link.

"Voltage and frequency move together" fails above rated speed, where voltage stays at rated. An online UPS in an eco or bypass mode does change over, so the common mistake must name double conversion, as source 7 does.
